$comment: Separate from the mint service because the service's addresses depend on the asset id, and the id only exists once this transaction has picked the outpoint it is derived from: the engine fixes compile params before it resolves inputs, so one action cannot issue an asset and pay it to an address derived from it.
description: Issue tUSDT, the testnet stablecoin the oracle_demo mint service sells: a fixed supply with no reissuance token, paid to your wallet. Lock it into a treasury with ../txmanifest.json CreateTreasury.

tusdt.description: One tUSDT asset. The instance file records its id, which CreateTreasury takes as USD_ASSET.

IssueUSDT.description: Issue the whole tUSDT supply to your wallet and write the instance file recording its asset id.
IssueUSDT.intent: issue {params.SUPPLY} base units of a new tUSDT asset

SUPPLY.description: tUSDT to issue, in base units. 8 decimal places, like L-BTC, so the default is 1,000,000 tUSDT.

inputs.description: Wallet L-BTC UTXO whose outpoint defines the asset id. It also pays the fee.

ui.label: input that defines the tUSDT asset

outputs.description: The tUSDT supply, to your wallet.
L-BTC change from the issuing input.
